scope: execution framework only; no eligibility, generation or scorer numerical changes
entrypoint: nanobody_opt.pr100_wide_screen.screen_phase; worker phase screen; score phase dispatches here above 128 inputs per GPU

input_contract.sequences: canonical unique inputs; duplicates are refused
input_contract.previously_evaluated_hashes: optional authoritative caller-supplied exclusions; excluded before submitting any lease
input_contract.freshness_limit: Without previous-evaluation history, fresh means unique fresh evaluations within this invocation, not never evaluated in an earlier epoch

bounds.absolute_deadline: Required deadline_unix; wall_seconds and monotonic time can only shorten it
bounds.cleanup: Dedicated subreaper owns only its GPU lease runners and descendants; bounded cleanup before another wave
bounds.existing_output: Refused; cached reports cannot be counted as new evaluations

verified: every eligible input is submitted at most once
actual validated group entries determine fresh completion counts
completed waves survive deadlines, partial probes and later invalid results
GPU lock remains held through owned cleanup and can be reacquired in the next wave
unavailable leases and incomplete probes do not count as fresh results
prior evaluation exclusions, clock movement, launch failure and SIGTERM are accounted for

limitations: No claim that 4800 evaluations fit within a real epoch
No real GPU throughput or native eligibility yield was measured
The caller must supply authoritative historical exclusions to guarantee globally new inputs
Only complete validated probe groups are retained; incomplete groups remain uncounted
The live supervisor remains responsible for chain-clock rollover and the enclosing process deadline
